text: どうやら　めずらしい　ポケモンの　カセキ　らしいんですよ

structure.jp: めずらしい　ポケモンの　カセキ
structure.en: a fossil of a rare Pokémon
it seems to be, you see

patterns.name: 〜らしい
patterns.explanation: らしい after a word says 'it seems to be', going by what you heard or can tell. It often pairs with どうやら, 'apparently'. カセキ　らしい = 'it seems to be a fossil'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: んです at the end gives the sentence an explaining tone, like 'the thing is'. It is the spoken form of のです. らしいんです = 'you see, it seems to be'.
